mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inhibitor that may increase eslicarbazepine levels, while eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 potentially reducing turmeric's efficacy; additive antiplatelet effects also possible.
action: Monitor eslicarbazepine levels and clinical response; counsel on bleeding precautions; consider spacing administration or alternative herbal products if bleeding risk increases.
